mission_07: For the three-card problem: 3 outcomes have red face up, 2 of them have red on the other side.
In Monty Hall, Monty always opens a door with a goat — this gives information.
Simulate Monty Hall with many trials to see the 2/3 vs 1/3 result.
Monty's choice is constrained: he cannot open the car door or your chosen door.
The switch wins 2/3 of the time because you initially picked wrong 2/3 of the time.
